title: Gayatri Balasamy v. ISG Novasoft Technologies Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Gayatri Balasamy v. ISG Novasoft Technologies Ltd., 2025 INSC 605
content.court: Supreme Court of India, Constitution Bench
content.facts: The Constitution Bench considered the scope of judicial power under Section 34 in challenges to arbitral awards.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether and to what extent a court hearing a Section 34 application can modify an arbitral award.
content.ratioDecidendi: The Court recognised a limited power in specified circumstances but rejected any general merits-based appellate power over arbitral awards.
content.holding: Section 34 remains a narrow supervisory remedy; any intervention must stay within the statutory and judicially recognised limits.
content.relevance: Current Constitution Bench authority for the scope of Section 34 review and modification.
